blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P42-minimum wage increase for private sector workers in Central Visayas was affirmed by the National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC). This was confirmed by Labor Secretary and NWPC Chairperson Francis Tolentino at the commission’s deliberation, which was held at the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Regional Office VII in Cebu last Saturday. The decision was made by five commissioners present, affirming the new wage order issued by the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board.
